answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, like a deposit that earns trust only through honest work. A single attacker can still buy one identity, but cloning thousands means locking thousands of deposits, so the cost scales with the fraud. Reputation then accrues per identity, like nectar gathered slowly in an oasis: it cannot be copied, only earned. A newcomer's pigment of trust is pale at first and deepens with verified history, so fake swarms stay visibly cheap and untrusted.
